classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Flyby Attack
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: Gain Flyby Attack as a bonus feat at 1st level.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Momentum
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: While airborne, gain a competence bonus on damage rolls: +1 at 2nd level, +2 at 5th, and +3 at 8th.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Power Dive
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: At 2nd level, a successful dive charge attack deals an additional 1d6 damage.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Maneuverability Increase
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: Increase flight maneuverability by one category at 3rd level and again at 7th level, to a maximum of perfect.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Speed
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: Increase speed by 10 feet at 3rd level and by another 10 feet at 8th level, for +20 feet total.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Death From Above
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: While airborne above a foe, gain a competence bonus on attacks: +1 at 4th level and +2 at 9th level.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Range Increase
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: At 4th level while airborne, increase weapon range increments and the range of spells requiring ranged attack rolls by 50%.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Swoop
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: At 6th level, as a full-round action while flying in a straight line, move your speed and make one melee attack against each declared foe within reach along the path. Each foe beyond the first imposes a cumulative -1 attack penalty; this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

classes/aerial-avenger-980.name: Terrifying Shriek
classes/aerial-avenger-980.description: At 10th level add a terrifying shriek to a Swoop. Creatures within 50 feet of the first attack make a Will save (DC 20 + Charisma modifier) or become panicked for 1d6+4 rounds.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Partial Exotic Proficiency
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 1st level reduce the nonproficiency penalty with exotic weapons from -4 to -2; at 2nd level reduce it to -1.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Full Exotic Proficiency
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 3rd level become proficient with all exotic weapons.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Improvised Throwing Weapons
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 3rd level use artisan's tools and at least 1 hour to fashion an improvised throwing weapon from a liftable object. It has a 10-foot range increment, deals 1d6 damage, and has a 20/x2 critical; you are proficient with it.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Exotic Focus
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 4th level gain +1 on attack rolls with any exotic weapon; this does not stack with Weapon Focus.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Improvised Melee Weapons
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 4th level use artisan's tools and at least 1 hour to fashion an improvised melee weapon from a liftable object. It deals 1d6 damage with a 20/x2 critical; long items can have reach and protruding items grant +2 on disarm attempts.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Exotic Specialization
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 5th level gain +2 damage with exotic weapons; for ranged exotic weapons the target must be within 30 feet. This does not stack with Weapon Specialization.

classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.name: Greater Improvised Weapons
classes/exotic-weapon-master-610.description: At 5th level your improvised throwing and melee weapons can deal 2d6 damage instead of 1d6.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Weapon Finesse
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 1st level use Dexterity instead of Strength on attack rolls with a katana; this is the class feature version and applies even though normal Weapon Finesse would not apply to a katana.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Canny Defense
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 1st level while unarmored and wielding a katana, add Intelligence bonus to the Dexterity bonus that modifies AC; positive modifiers are lost while flat-footed.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Lightning Blade
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 2nd level add Charisma modifier to initiative checks in addition to Dexterity modifier.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Bonus Feat
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 4th and 9th level choose a bonus feat from the iaijutsu master list, meeting any prerequisite chain shown by the source list.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Strike from the Void
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 5th level add Charisma modifier to each extra damage die gained from the Iaijutsu Focus skill.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: One Strike, Two Cuts
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 8th level make two attacks with a katana as a standard action, allowing movement and two attacks in the same round or two attacks in an iaijutsu duel strike phase.

classes/iaijutsu-master-634.name: Strike with No Thought
classes/iaijutsu-master-634.description: At 10th level, if combat begins within melee range of an opponent, gain a free surprise round even when opponents know you are present; the only action in that surprise round is a katana attack action.
